bio.zh: 中央資管碩士，碩士論文研究共同基金持股序列的「下一籃」推薦，結合 DNNTSP 模型與外部特徵做實證分析。
bio.en: Master's graduate of NCU Information Management. Her thesis studies next-basket recommendation from mutual fund holding sequences, combining the DNNTSP model with external features.
